Inventory & Tinkering

Salvage loot into materials, then tinker your gear — a craft of Dereth. Equip an item to gain its bonus.

DERETH

A World of Asheron's Call
Auberean turns, and the portals of Dereth open once more. Bind your soul to a Lifestone, hone the skills you choose — no classes bind you here — and walk a fractured isle of ancient ruins, wandering portals, and the insectoid Olthoi.
⌨ Desktop controls required. Dereth is played with a keyboard & mouse (WASD to move, mouse to look) — on-screen touch controls aren't supported yet, so it won't be playable on a phone or tablet. If you have a keyboard and mouse attached, tap Continue anyway.
